name: PETGAS
recent: PETRONAS Gas 于 2026 年 11 月 1 日完成将气体处理与公用事业业务转移至 PG Gas Processing 的内部重组。同期，EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东持续申报股权变动。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比与环比均下降，净利则大致持平。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 1 日完成将气体处理业务转移至 PG Gas Processing 的内部重组。
公司同时完成公用事业业务的转移。
EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动，需留意其持股变化。
KWAP 于 2026 年 10 月 9 日申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 1,500,956,000，环比下降 5.3%，同比下降 5.6%；净利为 MYR 453,333,000，环比增长 3.3%，同比增长 0.7%；净利率为 30.2%，高于上一期的 27.7%。

recent_en: PETRONAS Gas completed the internal reorganisation transferring its gas processing and utilities businesses to PG Gas Processing effective 1 Nov 2026. Meanwhile, major shareholders including EPF and KWAP continued to file changes in their shareholdings. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue declined both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter, while net income was broadly flat.
notable_en: The company completed the internal reorganisation transferring its gas processing business to PG Gas Processing effective 1 Nov 2026.
The company also completed the transfer of its utilities business.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings between October and November.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in shareholdings between October and November, and its shareholding changes should be noted.
KWAP filed a change in shareholding on 9 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,500,956,000, down 5.3% quarter-on-quarter and 5.6% year-on-year; net income was MYR 453,333,000, up 3.3% quarter-on-quarter and 0.7% year-on-year; net margin was 30.2%, higher than 27.7% in the previous period.
